name: Black and Yellow Kanjivaram Silk Saree
description: Stunning black and yellow Kanjivaram silk saree with rich gold zari work. Features traditional floral motifs throughout the body and an elaborate gold zari border with intricate paisley and floral patterns. The yellow pallu contrasts beautifully with the black body. Comes with a black blouse piece with gold zari work. Perfect for weddings and grand festive occasions.

name: Black Body Yellow Pallu Silk Saree
description: Elegant black silk saree with gold zari butta motifs scattered across the body. Yellow tissue-style pallu with matching gold zari border. Heavy traditional border featuring floral and paisley designs in gold. Ideal for wedding receptions, engagement ceremonies, and festive functions.

name: Yellow and Black Silk Festive Saree
description: Bright yellow silk saree paired with contrasting black panel and gold zari work. Traditional floral and paisley zari border. Versatile piece suitable for festive celebrations, temple visits, and traditional gatherings.

name: Mauve Pink Black and Maroon Silk Saree
description: Luxurious silk saree in soft mauve pink with black and maroon panels. Heavy gold zari border featuring intricate paisley patterns. Multi-tonal design makes this a statement piece for weddings, receptions, and high-end festive events.

name: Sky Blue Linen Saree with Pink Flamingo Print
description: Breezy sky blue linen saree featuring playful pink flamingo and tropical foliage prints. Comes with a contrasting pink printed blouse piece. Light silver zari border. Perfect for daytime casual outings, brunches, office wear, and summer events.

name: Yellow Linen Saree with Blue Flamingo Print
description: Vibrant yellow linen saree with striking blue flamingo and tropical leaf prints. Includes a coordinating blue printed blouse piece. Lightweight and easy to drape. Great for casual outings, festive days, and fun summer occasions.

name: Sky Blue Linen Saree with Pink Flamingo Print Variant
description: Refreshing sky blue linen saree with detailed pink flamingo motifs and lush foliage prints. Paired with a pink printed contrast blouse. Soft silver border. Ideal for daytime events, office wear, and casual gatherings.

name: Sky Blue Flamingo Saree with Pink Blouse Set
description: Sky blue linen saree with pink flamingo prints presented as a complete saree and blouse set. Contrasting bright pink printed blouse piece. Lightweight, comfortable, and easy to style for casual or semi-formal occasions.

name: Yellow Linen Saree with Royal Blue Print
description: Sunshine yellow linen saree with bold royal blue flamingo and palm leaf prints. Comes with a matching royal blue printed blouse piece. Light and airy fabric. Perfect for festive casuals, office wear, and brunch events.

name: Yellow Linen and Blue Blouse Saree Set
description: Yellow linen saree featuring blue flamingo and foliage prints, paired with a coordinating blue printed blouse. Modern, lightweight, and perfect for casual and semi-formal events.

name: Sky Blue Saree with Pink Print and Pink Blouse
description: Sky blue linen saree with playful pink flamingo and tropical prints. Includes a vibrant pink printed blouse piece. Comfortable to wear and stylish for casual events, lunches, and outings.

name: Yellow Linen Saree with Teal Blue Blouse
description: Cheerful yellow linen saree with blue flamingo prints in a beautiful tropical setting. Paired with a teal blue contrast blouse with similar print theme. Lightweight, breezy, and ideal for daytime events.

name: Sky Blue Saree with Pink Print and Pink Blouse Set
description: Sky blue linen saree with elegant pink flamingo and tropical foliage prints. Includes a bright pink printed contrast blouse. Perfect blend of comfort and style for casual gatherings, office days, and festive occasions.

name: White and Maroon Floral Block Print Cotton Saree
description: Crisp white cotton saree covered in maroon and dusty blue floral block prints, framed by a rich maroon block-printed border with white floral and paisley patterns. A soft grey pom-pom trim finishes the hem. Comes with a contrasting maroon cotton blouse piece accented with white wave motifs. Easy to drape and ideal for daytime functions, temple visits, and casual gatherings.

name: White and Black Ethnic Block Print Cotton Saree
description: Pristine white cotton saree with a bold black ethnic block-print border featuring traditional paisley and floral motifs in a scalloped arrangement. The hem carries playful multi-coloured pom-pom tassels in pink, yellow, green and orange. Paired with a plain black cotton blouse piece for a striking monochrome look. Lightweight and comfortable, perfect for office wear, casual outings, and festive daytime events.

name: Yellow and Black Floral Block Print Cotton Saree
description: Cheerful yellow cotton saree with a black ombre upper panel, both halves scattered with delicate white floral block prints. A bright red pom-pom trim runs along the hem and lifts the palette. Comes with a contrasting white and black floral block-print blouse piece. Easy to drape and great for festive casuals, day functions, and family gatherings.

name: Turquoise Blue Tulip Batik Print Cotton Saree
description: Vibrant turquoise blue cotton saree featuring crisp white tulip and leaf motifs in a hand-finished batik print, with characteristic black batik splatter accents across the body. Finished with a black pom-pom trim and paired with a matching turquoise blouse piece. Lightweight and breezy, perfect for daytime events, brunches, and summer occasions.

name: Pink and Black Paisley Ombre Cotton Saree
description: Striking ombre cotton saree shading from bright pink to deep black, scattered with paisley and teardrop block prints throughout. The pallu carries a heavy fern-leaf block-print border in muted black and grey, finished with pink pom-pom tassels. Comes with a contrasting white and grey block-print blouse piece. A statement piece for festive afternoons and stylish gatherings.

name: Maroon and Orange Peacock Block Print Cotton Saree
description: Rich maroon cotton saree adorned with intricate orange and white block prints featuring peacock and paisley motifs along the body and pallu. A bright orange pom-pom trim runs along the hem. Comes with a contrasting plain navy blue cotton blouse piece. Bold and traditional, ideal for festive occasions, family functions, and daytime ceremonies.

name: Magenta Abstract Batik Cotton Saree
description: Bold magenta cotton saree with an abstract batik print featuring black, orange and white motifs in a free-flowing artistic arrangement. Finished with multi-coloured pom-pom tassels along the hem. Comes with a coordinating white and pink ethnic floral block-print blouse piece. A modern, expressive piece for casual outings, art events, and creative gatherings.

name: Black and White Leaf and Wave Block Print Cotton Saree
description: Classic black cotton saree featuring white block-printed wheat and leaf motifs across the body, with a striking white wave pattern along the lower half. A crisp white pom-pom trim finishes the hem. Comes with a coordinating black and white floral batik blouse piece. Versatile and timeless, perfect for office wear, casual events, and evening gatherings.

name: Maroon and Blue Shibori Tie-Dye Cotton Saree
description: Earthy maroon cotton saree with a soft blue and white shibori tie-dye section at the pallu, finished with multi-coloured pom-pom tassels. Comes with a plain maroon cotton blouse piece for a clean coordinated look. Lightweight and full of artisanal character, ideal for casual outings, daytime events, and relaxed gatherings.

name: Black and White Fern Batik Cotton Saree
description: Deep black cotton saree with delicate white batik fern and leaf cluster motifs across the body, finished with a soft white batik-effect upper panel. A bright red pom-pom trim brings a pop of colour to the hem. Comes with a plain black cotton blouse piece for understated elegance. Comfortable to drape and ideal for casual events, office wear, and evening occasions.
